title: Pawn breakthrough
summary: Three pawns against three: sacrifice to break through.

steps.md: Three pawns against three. A clever **sacrifice** opens the road for one pawn!

steps.prompt: Break through! Start with the middle pawn.
steps.explain: Nobody can stop the a-pawn now!
steps.hint: Push the middle pawn to b6.

steps.question: Why does the breakthrough work?
choices: The black king is too far away
steps.explain: The king cannot catch the last pawn.

steps.prompt: Now play it out against the computer!
